name: Hyde Park
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Hyde Park, NY
blurb: Bard Rock, on the Vanderbilt Mansion grounds, with Esopus Island a short way upriver and the Esopus Meadows lighthouse across and north.

tide.label: NOAA 8518951 Hyde Park
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8518951 at Hyde Park, about a mile from the launch.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.

current.label: NOAA ACT3751_1 Hyde Park
current.note: Current from NOAA station ACT3751_1 at Hyde Park, about a mile from the launch. NOAA publishes a flood heading there but no ebb, so the ebb is the river’s own axis.
